followUpActions.title: Inspect primary core implementation before editing
followUpActions.reason: Core candidates combine path, density, and git-history signals.
followUpActions.passCheck: The agent can name the target implementation files and likely callers before making changes.

followUpActions.title: Make the requested behavior change in primary source first
followUpActions.reason: Supporting files should follow source behavior, not substitute for the implementation change.
followUpActions.passCheck: The requested behavior is implemented in source code and not only reflected in docs, locale, or fixture files.

followUpActions.title: Sync localization files when user-facing text changes
followUpActions.reason: Localization files are supporting hotspots and often need companion edits after UI or message changes.
followUpActions.passCheck: Changed or introduced user-facing strings have matching locale updates, or the agent states why none are needed.

followUpActions.title: Sync documentation when behavior or workflow changes
followUpActions.reason: Documentation hotspots are useful follow-up checks but should not be mistaken for core implementation.
followUpActions.passCheck: Docs that describe the changed behavior are updated, or the agent states why docs are unaffected.

followUpActions.title: Run focused validation for changed core or hotspot areas
followUpActions.reason: Detected tests or fixtures can anchor validation.
followUpActions.passCheck: Relevant focused tests, build, lint, smoke, or caller/API checks pass or failures are reported with exact output.

agentGuidance.stance: Use the pack as an evidence starting point, then inspect source files and rerun narrower analysis when project-specific noise is visible.

optionalReruns.reason: Supporting hotspots are visible; rerun with explicit ignores if they distract from the requested implementation change.

reportFiltering: Keep primary source candidates and supporting files in separate sections.
When a locale, docs, fixture, config, or migration file matters, explain it as companion sync or evidence, not as the primary implementation.
Do not recommend creating, editing, or populating internal core boundary configuration as a user-facing action.

Do not render the internal core boundary file name or internal core boundary label in user-visible reports, evidence boundaries, recommendations, or handoff prompts; use configured core boundary, inferred core boundary, or affected core files.

For an affected core chain, review diagnostic coverage through the shared observability rubric. If inspected evidence confirms that a named segment lacks readable logs or correlation, keep the gap and its causal impact as a reader-facing finding; do not infer the gap from logger-call counts or a runtime-only access failure.
If explicit ignores are used, mention the patterns and do not hide changed files that are directly relevant to the user's request.

reviewMatrix.title: Core candidates and supporting hotspots are separated
reviewMatrix.note: Primary hot file lists should not be led by locale, docs, tests, fixtures, config, or migrations.

reviewMatrix.title: Analysis can drive implementation work
reviewMatrix.note: For change/fix/optimize requests, convert follow-up actions into edits before final validation.

reviewMatrix.title: History uses 30/90/180 style windows with confidence notes
reviewMatrix.note: Low history confidence should downgrade hotspot certainty, not block source inspection.

reviewMatrix.title: Large git output has explicit bounded handling
reviewMatrix.note: A non-empty tracked-file profile is the first regression guard for large repositories.

reviewMatrix.title: Language and framework signals are visible
reviewMatrix.note: Framework signals guide inspection; they do not replace reading implementation files.

reviewMatrix.title: Runtime, CI, and test claims stay unverified until separately checked
reviewMatrix.note: Reports should cite commands for local counts and mark non-executed claims as UNVERIFIED.

reviewMatrix.title: Affected core chains receive a diagnostic-coverage review
reviewMatrix.note: The static pack requests a semantic review; source, executable-route, or captured-output evidence must confirm any missing-log finding.

reviewMatrix.title: Changed surfaces have companion evidence checks
reviewMatrix.note: Companion drift findings are advisory; update the companion file or document why it is not needed.

reviewMatrix.title: Agents can rerun or filter instead of accepting noisy defaults
reviewMatrix.note: Optional filters are analysis aids; they should be disclosed when used.
